title: Dropout Layer
prompt: Implement a dropout layer that applies random neuron deactivation during training to prevent overfitting in neural networks. The layer should randomly zero out a proportion of input elements based on a dropout rate p, scale the remaining values by 1/(1-p) to maintain expected values, and pass inputs unchanged during inference. During backpropagation, gradients must be masked with the same dropout pattern and scaled by the same factor to ensure proper gradient flow.
